name: Ethena USDe OFT

requirements.label: Admin power is not a bare key
A confirmed delay before changes apply, no bypass
Bypass paths of the delay checked and ruled out
Price feed not under one hand
No key shared with another tracked protocol

exit_window: a delay with a bypass, or one not ruled out

narrative.summary: A real 5-of-10 Safe - and the same 10 signers, as an exact set, already control Ethereum L1’s own tracked Ethena Safe. A real delay is queued (Ownable2Step pending) but not active yet.
narrative.tag: cross-exposure: 80 - same 10 signers as Ethereum L1
narrative.detail: owner() is the current, active authority (the 5-of-10 Safe); pendingOwner() shows an in-progress transfer to a real TimelockController with a 1-day delay, on which that same Safe already holds every role - so even once accepted, authority doesn’t change hands, just gets a delay. Scored on the CURRENT state (no delay in effect), not the pending one.

steps.what: owner() on the contract: the holder
getMinDelay() on the holder (OpenZeppelin TimelockController), in seconds
